component.name: drivesync
component.summary: Unofficial two-way sync of selected Google Drive folders

description.p: drivesync mirrors the Google Drive folders you choose into a local folder and keeps both sides in sync. It is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Google, and it is very early software: keep a backup.

It never deletes outright (deleted files go to the Drive trash or a local trash folder), keeps both versions on conflicts, and runs inside a kernel sandbox that limits it to its own folders and outgoing HTTPS.
